## Goal
A page for Pat or a helper: how to open the printable summary, print it or save it as a PDF, and how to read each line (requested, confirmed, came back, waiting for you). Includes what the page says when practice mode is on, and that a low score does not mean safe.

## Blocked: what in-house must provide first
In-house must ship the print-ready report page (ROADMAP 0.4 order item 3; `wizard/report.py` and its template) and provide the exact headings, button labels and sentences with file:line, the print steps for Windows 10 (browser print dialog, "Save as PDF" if offered), and what the page says in practice mode. The facts come from WO-299's `report_lines`; the page quotes those sentences.

Not startable by a vendor. In-house unblocks it by changing the status line and posting a GO.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Under 600 words, reading level grade 8 or lower; a table of "what the line says / what it means" with at most 8 rows.
2. Every heading and button quoted exists in the app; every report sentence quoted comes from `report_lines` (WO-299) or the template, cited with file:line.
3. States the practice-mode wording exactly as the report does and says no requests have gone out in that case.
4. Never says "erased" or "removed forever"; says "requested", "confirmed", "came back".
5. Print help covers one page, black and white, and large text; checked against the print stylesheet in-house provides.
6. Forbidden-words check passes.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
